info.title: Kobe API
info.description: Team-scoped routes act on the session's active team (spec D9); send X-Kobe-Team on changes. Errors are `{code, message}`. Authentication is the Better Auth session cookie.

get.summary: List the viewer's threads (or a project's readable threads), newest first
get.description: Keyset pagination on (last_activity_at, id). Never Trash. Without `project_id`, pinned and archived threads are left out (`/v1/threads/pinned`, `/archived`, CE19). With `q`, full-text search (KOBE-33): web-search syntax (`"phrase"`, `-exclude`, `or`) over user/assistant messages (all terms in one message) and titles (plus fuzzy title matching), ranked by relevance with snippets; `cursor` is then a search cursor and `limit` is capped at 50. Reads Postgres only (never wakes a sandbox).

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

200.description: A page of threads (`ThreadSearchPage` when `q` is given).

409.description: `no_active_team` or `team_mismatch` (stale tab), or a thread conflict.

503.description: `search_timeout`: the search exceeded its time limit.

post.description: With `agent_id`, the thread pins the agent's current published version (D19). Suspended, archived and never-published agents answer 409 `agent_unavailable`. post.summary: Send a message: starts a run, or queues it behind the thread's active run (D17)
post.description: Owner only. The run is created queued and starts at once when nothing is active and the thread is not interrupted; otherwise `queued` is true and it starts in order (Retry runs first). Follow it with `GET /v1/runs/{id}/events`. `parent_entry_id` branches from an entry (edit-and-regenerate); absent = the thread's leaf when the run starts. `mentions` (KOBE-223) lists the workspace paths the member picked with `@`: each must be a live file of the owner's synced workspace with no invisible, format or shell characters, and only its `@file(<path>)` marker in `content` is replaced by the absolute `/workspace/...` path before the run is stored; any other `@file(...)` text stays as written. Steering and editing a queued message take `mentions` the same way.

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key (1–128 visible ASCII characters), unique per thread: repeating the request with the same key answers with the run the first one created.

403.description: `not_a_team_member`, `forbidden` (team role, or a deactivated account), or `read_only` (a project reader of a shared thread).

404.description: `thread_not_found`, `entry_not_found` or `file_not_found` (unknown, someone else's or another thread's `file_ids`).

413.description: `message_too_large`: the files add up to more than one message may (403 `quota_exceeded`: no storage left).

422.description: `attachments_unavailable` (this site has no workspace storage) or `invalid_parent_entry` (`parent_entry_id` is a note from Kobe, not a message), or `invalid_mention` (a `mentions` path is outside `/workspace`, holds invisible, format or shell characters, or is not a file in the workspace).

429.description: `budget_exhausted`: no new runs at 100 % of a budget (D30).

post.summary: Stop: cancel the active run (Pi aborts), or delete a queued message (D17)
post.description: The run ends `cancelled` at once with `run.interrupted {reason: cancelled}`. Stopping the active run pauses the messages queued behind it (`queue_paused`) until the user resumes the queue or sends a new message; deleting a queued message does not pause. Idempotent for a cancelled run.

post.summary: Compact the thread's conversation now

Runs as a compaction run (one active run per thread, budgets and usage apply) in the owner's workspace, which is woken if needed; answers once Pi has written the summary, whose `compaction` entry is then in the thread's entries. Each error code has one fixed message.

post.summary: Allow or deny a pending approval (only the run's user)
post.description: Allow signs HMAC(team, run, tool_call_id, tool, token expiry, canonical input) so exactly the approved input runs, once. `remember` (allow only) writes a user allow rule for exactly this tool with a scope (this conversation, until end of today, this run, 1 day, 30 days, until revoked) and optionally only this exact action; the server computes the expiry and the pattern and applies the team's remember limits. It never lifts an ask or deny rule, nor applies to scheduled or auto runs. Pending approvals expire after 1 hour; the run then ends.
